mechanism: Methimazole may increase corticosteroid metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing budesonide efficacy, while budesonide may suppress immune function and mask signs of agranulocytosis from methimazole.
action: Monitor thyroid function and clinical response to budesonide; consider dose adjustments if efficacy decreases; ensure regular CBC monitoring for methimazole-related myelosuppression.
